children: Hemnet’s preliminary, unaudited October net sales were SEK 112.2M, down 25% from SEK 148.7M a year earlier. Published listings rose 12% to 15.3K, including approximately 6,000 free listings; ARPL increased 12%.
Revenue declined despite higher ARPL; the new listing model significantly impacts year-over-year comparatives.
Volume growth includes free listings and listings under the new payment model, so it may not translate directly into current paid revenue.
Higher average revenue per paid listing partly offsets the reported sales decline.
Free listings launched October 20 and are included in published listings, making paid conversion and monetization key to track.
The release gives no year-over-year comparison; subsequent paid-listing conversion will indicate the new formats’ revenue effect.

This is an early read on Hemnet’s transition to new listing formats, with year-over-year comparisons affected by the “Sell first, pay later” model. The next catalyst is the fourth-quarter financial detail in the year-end report scheduled for 28 January 2027, including how the new formats affect paid listings and revenue.
